title: The Two Friends and the Bear
hook: Two friends walked into the forest... but only one stayed loyal.

segments.text: Two friends walked together through a quiet forest...
They laughed and talked along the way.
Suddenly... a bear appeared in front of them.
One friend quickly climbed up a tree.
The other was left alone on the ground.
He lay down... pretending to be dead.
The bear came closer and sniffed him.
The friend climbed down and asked, "What did the bear say?"
"Never trust a friend who leaves you behind," he replied.
